## Documentation Change

Use this template only when the owner explicitly requests a pull request. Normal work takes place in `main`.

### Changed Sections

Identify the sections and the reason for the change.

### Product Impact

- [ ] MVP scope and the frozen concept are preserved.
- [ ] Any product decision change was explicitly approved.

### Validation

- [ ] Russian and English editions were updated and read side by side.
- [ ] Contracts, numbers, links, and acceptance criteria are consistent.
- [ ] Both compiled PRDs were rebuilt.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_docs.py` passes.
